title.zh: 原住民族部落公開定位點

description.en: Public village names, traditional romanization and associated groups from the Council of Indigenous Peoples.
description.zh: 原住民族委員會公開之部落名稱、傳統名制羅馬拼音及族別。

limitation.en: Reference points locate published villages, not traditional territories or access rights. Catalogue listing dates are preserved separately; historical founding dates are not inferred. Conflicting coordinates and county mismatches are excluded.
limitation.zh: 公開定位點不代表傳統領域或進入權利；另保留資料列載日期，不推定部落成立年代。座標互相矛盾或不符來源縣市者排除。

description.en: Actual route geometry from the Tourism Administration release, filtered to named historical trails listed as open and publicly accessible.
description.zh: 交通部觀光署發布之實際路線，僅收錄名稱為古道且來源標示開放及可公開進入者。

limitation.en: A selection of public historical trails, not a complete Indigenous-trail inventory. Open status is a release snapshot; official closures and community restrictions take precedence. Eight separate CIP historical study profiles contain no coordinates and are not drawn as invented routes.
limitation.zh: 僅呈現公開古道選錄，非完整原住民族古道盤點；開放狀態為發布當時快照，以官方封閉公告及社群限制為準。另有八筆原民會歷史研究簡介，因未附座標，不虛構路線。

title.zh: 八筆臺灣原住民族古道研究簡介

description.en: Source historical narratives from a 2011 study, listed in 2023. The downloadable local profile library preserves the original Traditional Chinese text, study context and attribution.
description.zh: 原民會 2011 年研究、2023 年列載之歷史敘述；本地簡介保留原文、研究年代及出處，不作現況通行指南。

description.en: Public language-learning materials maintained by the Indigenous Languages Research and Development Foundation.
description.zh: 原住民族語言研究發展基金會維護的公開族語學習教材。

description.en: Search the official language dictionaries at their source; dictionary content is not copied into the atlas.
description.zh: 連至原始辭典查詢，地圖平台不另行重製辭典內容。
